'''AJ-291''' was an automated [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminal aboard [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[War Hammer]]''. It possessed some amount of artificial intelligence. In [[137 ABY]], during [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] ordered AJ-291 to add a certain crate to the requested equipment drop ordered for [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].
